# PulseHawk

> Independent blockchain measurement under load, across all chains. PulseHawk does its own measurement with its own nodes or header clients, publishes an open method, dates every number and releases the raw data. A brand of Vizora Digital UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Düsseldorf, Germany.

Services and prices (net, plus VAT where it applies, invoiced in euro, as of October 2026)
- TPS verification, review 250 € ($290)
- Launch measurement from 2,500 € ($2,900)
- Upgrade monitoring, ongoing measurement from 1,500 € ($1,750) per month
- Custom scope, on request

## Pages

- [Blockchains, measured under load](https://pulsehawk.io/): PulseHawk does its own blockchain measurement under load, with own nodes or header clients. Dated numbers, raw data and an open method for upgrades.
- [Independent TPS verification, claimed vs measured](https://pulsehawk.io/tps-verification): Independent TPS verification. We check a TPS claim against real network throughput in our own measurement and publish claimed vs measured, dated.
- [Testnet and mainnet launch measurement](https://pulsehawk.io/launch-measurement): Testnet stress test measurement and mainnet launch metrics. The first week after launch against the week before, from our own measurement, with raw data.
- [Hard fork and network upgrade monitoring](https://pulsehawk.io/upgrade-monitoring): Hard fork monitoring from our own measurement. Block time, difficulty and orphaned blocks compared before and after a network upgrade, with dated raw data.
- [How we measure](https://pulsehawk.io/method): Our open method. Block time distribution, stale block rate, propagation delay, confirmation time and fees, from our own measurement in dated windows.
- [How we stay independent](https://pulsehawk.io/independence): Five rules for every PulseHawk measurement. Data published whatever the result, paid work marked as paid, price fixed in advance, no client tokens.
- [Track record](https://pulsehawk.io/track-record): Every PulseHawk estimate and comparison, scored against the counted result. With link, date, our value, the window, deviation and status for each entry.
- [Corrections](https://pulsehawk.io/corrections): Every correction to a PulseHawk page, dated. What was wrong, the corrected text and who reported it. Found an error? Write to us and we add it here.
- [About PulseHawk](https://pulsehawk.io/about): Who runs PulseHawk and who pays us. Fees for paid measurements, the price fixed before the first block, no tokens held. We measure, others decide.
- [Network upgrade calendar](https://pulsehawk.io/upgrades): Network upgrade calendar with upcoming hard forks across chains. Testnet and mainnet dates, status and the official source for every single entry.
- [Zcash NU7 block times, expected and counted](https://pulsehawk.io/zcash-nu7): Zcash NU7 activates at block 3,543,405 and cuts the block time from 75 s to 25 s. Our forecast, mainnet and testnet block times counted, 500 block spans.
- [Kaspa network measurements](https://pulsehawk.io/cases/kaspa): Kaspa block rate and fees against new issuance. Every number is dated and marked as our own measurement or as a series we take over and name.
- [The Alexandria Protocol, independent technical and usability review](https://pulsehawk.io/cases/alexandria): Independent technical and usability review of the Alexandria Protocol, 7 to 16 October 2026. Every finding is dated and kept apart from team reports.
- [Request a measurement](https://pulsehawk.io/contact): Request an independent blockchain measurement. Tell us network, scope, timing and budget. We reply to each request by email within one business day.
- [PulseHawk Measurement Framework](https://pulsehawk.io/standard/): The rules every PulseHawk report follows, whatever it measures. Marked values, UTC windows, raw data with sha256, fixed IDs and five report types.
- [PulseHawk Upgrade Report, specification v1.0](https://pulsehawk.io/standard/upgrade-report/): How PulseHawk measures a network upgrade on PoW and DAG chains. Seven fixed values from 24 hours before to 72 hours after the activation height.
- [Zcash NU7 upgrade report](https://pulsehawk.io/reports/zcash-nu7): Zcash NU7 upgrade report PH-UR-2026-001. Seven fixed values from 24 hours before to 72 hours after block 3,543,405, each dated, with raw data.
